- `dist_pp`: Tensor of shape $[N, 1]$ storing Euclidean distances [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly defines `dist_pp` in the `mip_scales` function as the result of `.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True)` applied to the difference between Gaussian centers (`pc.get_xyz`) and the camera center. In PyTorch, `.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True)` computes the L2 norm (Euclidean distance) along dimension 1 and preserves the dimension, resulting in a tensor of shape `[N, 1]` where N is the number of Gaussians. This matches the claim exactly.
